atoms.text: Class 5L had a contest to see who could pick up the most pieces of litter in the playground. The class made a bar chart to show how many pieces each pupil collected.

atoms.a: Which of these bar charts would tell you that the class has 17 pupils?
Which of these bar charts would tell you that one person picked up exactly nine pieces of litter?
Which chart says that three people picked up exactly four pieces of litter?
Which chart says nobody picked up exactly eight pieces?

instruction.text: Is the statement true or false?

atoms.a: One person picked up ten pieces of litter.
One person picked up exactly one piece of litter.
Four people picked up more than seven pieces of litter.
Two people picked up exactly seven pieces of litter.
Everybody picked up at least two pieces of litter.
